text: Arundhati Roy's Azadi was banned by the Jammu and Kashmir Home Department, which claimed that the books it ordered forfeited promoted false narratives and incited secessionism. In August 2025 the department, under Principal Secretary Chandraker Bharti, ordered the seizure of literature it said “propagates false narrative and secessionism in Jammu and Kashmir.” The notification covered roughly two dozen titles in the union territory and was widely criticised by Indian writers’ organisations and PEN.
